about: Text read from live homedepot.com product pages on 2026-11-10, in a browser, with no SerpApi search. Each page embeds a list of DescriptiveAttribute objects ({ "__typename": "DescriptiveAttribute", "name": "Bullet13", "value": "...", "bulleted": true }). The values below are those bullets that mention what the product includes or begin with a model number. Characters outside plain ASCII were replaced by a space when they were captured, so an apostrophe can appear as a space ("Operator s Manual"). The page is only served to a real browser session: a request without the browser's cookies gets a 2.5 KB placeholder.
